entities.name: One
entities.description: Female treefolk, Wrenn's first host from her homeworld, who served as her home and guide.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Dryad, planeswalker, who bonded with the treefolk One.

entities.name: Two
entities.description: Tree Wrenn found next to sing with after One.

events.summary: When One was done serving as Wrenn's partner, Wrenn let her take root on another unnamed Plane.
events.quote: When One was done serving her time as Wrenn's partner, Wrenn allowed her to take root on another, unnamed Plane.

events.summary: Wrenn found another tree to sing with, which would become Two.
events.quote: Wrenn then found another tree to sing with, which would become Two.
